explication: Kubectl AI is a command-line assistant that turns a natural-language request (optionally combined with YAML piped on stdin) into Kubernetes manifests, then lets the user refine, discard, or apply them. Its main runtime path is command setup and orchestration, OpenAI completion, optional Kubernetes OpenAPI schema lookup for function calling, interactive review, and application to the configured cluster. The sampled files show these calls directly; README documents pipe input/output and configuration options. Schema lookup can use either the cluster API or a configured URL.
